commit bc910d85e112fa0c6fac5f485f338be58117ea6b
Date: Fri Dec 05 07:23:20 2014 +0000

Student Scheduling  - added ability to override the following reservation properties (for any reservation)    - reservation priority, must be used, can assign over limit, allow overlap (time conflicts)  - see the unitime.reservation.* application properties    - for instance set unitime.reservation.canOverLimit.group to true to allow students meeting a student group reservation to be enrolled over the course / ...

result.reasoning: This commit introduced the switch statement in XReservation.java that sets reservation properties (priority, canAssignOverLimit, mustBeUsed, allowOverlap) based on reservation type. It contains a copy-paste error where the Group, Curriculum, and Course cases all incorrectly use the "Individual" ApplicationProperty variants instead of their own type-specific properties (Group, Curriculum, Course). The fix commit simply corrects these copy-paste mistakes to use the correct properties for each case, directly undoing the bug introduced here.
